name: Authentication Event Audit
description: Every authentication event (success, failure, MFA challenge, password change) is receipted and auditable. Events are queryable by principal, device, time range, and event type.
purpose: Provide a complete, immutable audit trail of every authentication event for security analysis and compliance.
acceptanceCriteria: Authentication event schema: event type, principal, device, timestamp, IP, user agent, outcome
Event types: login_success, login_failure, mfa_challenge, mfa_success, mfa_failure, password_change, token_refresh
All events receipted through the authority subsystem
Queryable by principal, device, time range, event type, outcome
Failure aggregation and threshold alerts supported
Event retention and archival policy defined
Events cannot be deleted or modified — only tombstoned when retention expires
